dictionary.title: One model for everything
dictionary.hint: Pick a model and apply it in one go to every task and every function, agents included.
dictionary.only_hint: Everything will use only the chosen model, with no backups.
dictionary.keep: This one first, current ones as backup
dictionary.keep_hint: The chosen model goes on top; the models already set stay as backups if it doesn't respond.
dictionary.confirm_only: Every task and every function will use only this model. Current settings will be replaced.
dictionary.confirm_keep: This model will be placed first in every task and every function. Current models stay as backups.
